purpose: Coverage map + the abstain rule for the hardware catalog SEED. This seed is deliberately SMALL and deliberately honest: it holds only parts whose specs were verified against a manufacturer source, each value citing that source. It is expected to grow. What matters is that a gap is an ABSTENTION, never a guess.
abstain_rule: If a requested part, spec, or field is NOT present in these catalog files, the answer is 'I don't have a verified spec for that — it's not in the catalog' plus a pointer to the manufacturer page. NEVER fill the gap from model memory. A confidently-recalled spec is exactly the failure this skill exists to prevent (see the gravity 385->386.4 and 21813 matrix cases in standing-principles.md). Coverage gaps are safe; fabricated specs are not.
known_gaps_abstain_here: Other 5203/5202 ratios (confirmed to exist: 1:1, 3.7, 26.9, 50.9, 99.5, 139; more may exist) — NOT seeded; abstain + point to gobilda.com. Do not interpolate an unseen ratio's stall torque from a seeded one (gearbox efficiency is measured per-ratio, not linear). NOTE: do not assume a ratio exists just because it is arithmetically plausible — e.g. there is NO 43.7:1 in this series (verified 2026-07-05); part existence is itself a lookup, not a guess.
REV UltraPlanetary assembled ratios beyond the bare HD Hex — abstain; the bare motor + a chosen cartridge ratio can be computed by motor_math.py, but assembled published figures are not seeded.
Batteries — for LEGALITY use the rules layer (manual-tables/table-12-4.json via ftc-rule-check), not this catalog. Detailed electrical specs: abstain.
Wheels — wheel_diameter_mm comes from the team's confirmed config (core-feature-model.yaml), not this catalog; motor_math.py takes it as a parameter.
Sensors (Limelight, Pinpoint, distance/color sensors) — not seeded; abstain.
math_note: Numeric answers (gear-ratio output RPM/torque, wheel linear speed, encoder ticks per unit distance) are produced ONLY by scripts/motor_math.py reading these files — never generated. The script itself abstains (errors clearly) on a part not in the catalog.
